incidents.what_happened: A minibus carrying tourists from Gujarat rammed into a truck, killing two people and injuring 11 others.
incidents.quote: at least two people were killed and 11 injured after a minibus carrying 30 passengers from surat, gujarat, who were on their way to visit taj mahal , rammed into a truck on agra-lucknow expressway in agra district around 4am on saturday.

incidents.what_happened: Two teenagers died and a third was critically injured when their speeding motorcycle crashed into a road divider near Agra Fort.
incidents.cause: high speed and loss of control
incidents.quote: two ba students were killed and another seriously injured after their speeding motorcycle rammed into a road divider near ramleela maidan gate, opposite agra fort, in rakabganj area on tuesday night.

incidents.place: Shamshan Ghat Road, near Taj Mahal
incidents.what_happened: A Czech tourist visiting the Taj Mahal was harassed and touched inappropriately by a man on Shamshan Ghat Road, who was later arrested after a CCTV scan.
incidents.quote: The alleged incident occurred on April 3 and the arrest was made after a thorough investigation, they said.
